provenance.processing: 12,362 overlapping 20 by 20 km blocks from 235 Copernicus GLO-30 tiles, chosen from a global WorldClim screen for cold, dry and rugged terrain (so hot deserts, Antarctica and the far north are not covered). Terrain features at 40 m, joined on (tile, r0, c0) from v3_candidates, feat_terrain_adv, feat_illum, feat_nasa and feat_nasa_power. Precipitation = POWER mm/day x 365. Missing values are null. Region labels are hand-written bounding boxes, approximate; blocks outside them are labelled with their Copernicus tile.
